decision: The queue shows only review-band work, highlighted, sorted by wait time
why: Analysts should spend attention where the model is least certain; clear approvals and declines don't need a person.
alternative: Every application in one list with filters.
value: 37 decisions instead of hundreds, each with an SLA.

decision: The manual-review band is drawn on the live score distribution
why: Moving the band is a policy decision; its volume impact should be visible before anyone argues about it.
value: Policy and workload discussed with the same picture.

decision: Models ship as champion/challenger with drift and fairness checks on the card
why: A credit model silently degrading is a customer harm, not just a metric.
alternative: Replace the model on a release date.
value: Drift pauses challenger routing automatically; people see why.

decision: Bureau calls are queued and retried; nothing auto-declines when a dependency is down
why: An outage must not turn into wrongful declines.
alternative: Fail closed and decline on timeout.
value: No wrongful declines during a partner outage; the queue drains on its own when the bureau returns.

decision: The two products appear as the physical cards customers carry
why: Operators decide between Credit and Store constantly; the objects make the choice concrete.
value: Less confusion between the two credit products.

decision: Opening Pay after 20+ minutes away plays a story-style recap of what changed (queue, scoring latency, disputes due, drift, pending policy), once per session; the ring chip replays it
why: Reviewers come back between other tools; a five-card recap, the story pattern popularized by social apps, beats scanning five screens for what moved.
value: Each change is one tap from its screen, and nothing auto-opens on a first visit or in a pinned demo state.

decision: The recap is computed from world events since the last visit (stored per viewer in local storage), and the scoring card follows the live P-812 fault
why: A recap that disagrees with Tidewatch would destroy trust in both.
alternative: A static digest written at a fixed time.
value: The same incident reads the same in Pay, Tidewatch and the request path.
